potentialIssues.description: impulse-learning-storage-complete validates RPC API infrastructure (PASS), but impulse-learning-in-rpc-api-only validates architectural separation (FAIL). This means RPC API is ready, but opencode still has duplicate learning algorithms.
potentialIssues.impact: RPC API is production-ready but not being used by opencode. Learning data still stored locally instead of in SurrealDB.
potentialIssues.resolution: Complete Phase 2 of impulse-learning-storage-complete: simplify opencode impulse-learning.ts to <50 lines, remove duplicate algorithms, implement sendToRpcApi() function

potentialIssues.description: impulse-learning-storage-complete and impulse-learning-in-rpc-api-only have overlapping validation checks. Both verify that learning algorithms exist in rpc-api.
potentialIssues.impact: Redundant validation checks increase test execution time but provide extra verification.
potentialIssues.resolution: Consider consolidating validation harnesses or making one depend on the other
